mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_invitation ( settlement_id, user_id, invitation_status, invited_at, accepted_at ) VALUES ( #{settlementId}, #{invitedUserId}, #{invitationStatus}, #{invitedAt}, #{acceptedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT invitation_id, settlement_id, user_id, invitation_status, invited_at, accepted_at FROM settlement_invitation WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId}

SELECT si.invitation_id AS invitationId, si.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.title AS settlementTitle, owner.name AS ownerName, si.invitation_status AS invitationStatus, si.invited_at AS invitedAt, si.accepted_at AS acceptedAt FROM settlement_invitation si JOIN settlement s ON s.settlement_id = si.settlement_id JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = s.owner_id WHERE si.user_id = #{userId} AND si.invitation_status = 'INVITED' ORDER BY si.invited_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_invitation SET invitation_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId} AND invitation_status = 'INVITED'
